design_configuration.interpretation: One broad raised S-shaped ribbon on thin illustrative slab, pronounced continuous median dorsal ridge and closely spaced transverse arcuate divisions on either side. Raised-fossil-relief convention. Underside slab solid. No producer or behavior certainty, no coexistence claim. Synonyms are not extra assets.
